versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\cmdkey.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'cmdkey.exe'
selection_cli_1:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' /g'
        - ' -g'
selection_cli_2:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' /u'
        - ' -u'
selection_cli_3:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' /p'
        - ' -p'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\cmdkey.exe" OR OriginalFileName="cmdkey.exe" CommandLine IN ("* /g*", "* -g*") CommandLine IN ("* /u*", "* -u*") CommandLine IN ("* /p*", "* -p*")
